> - Secondary metrics (e.g., recall for high-risk classes) with minimum thresholds.  
> - A representative test set validated for distributional alignment with production data."*  

**Trade-offs**:  
- **Pros**: Ensures metrics match real-world risks; prevents gaming; improves model suitability.
